listing.name: Sonic Riders — sonic-riders-recomp (teclilla18)
listing.summary: Native title/player setup described; the extent of working races, story progression and completion has not been confirmed. Switch is destination, not source. See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own USA GXEE8P full 1.4 GB ISO.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Follow the README’s SonicRiders-PC-Setup-<version>.zip or Switch setup with your own disc. The first local build takes approximately 10–30 minutes. Keep generated binaries private because they contain game-derived code.

warnings: Native title/player setup described; the extent of working races, story progression and completion has not been confirmed. Switch is destination, not source.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
